description: Companion -> host event carrying a user prompt that starts or continues a run (Q1-Q10 decision, transcribed 2026-11-01). text is required; id is an optional companion-chosen correlation identifier. The host answers with the run's record stream (system/init first, exactly one result last). Unknown fields are allowed (v1 ignore-unknown rule).

id.description: Optional companion-chosen identifier for this prompt, echoed by no other field in v1; present only when the companion sets it.

text.description: The prompt text. Required and non-empty.

uuid.description: Fresh UUID v4 per message in real runs. Type is string only: no format is enforced because the shipped fixtures use the placeholder string "<uuid>", which is not a valid UUID.

v.description: Contract version, currently 1. The companion events are additive in v1, so v stays 1 (Q1-Q10 decision: no version bump).

title: companion-ws v1 companion_prompt event (APP-2 M1)
